name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: DBKEY-LOOKUP BUILD, not for production: drops getCerts() entirely. Resolves our own cert via each mail identity's signing_cert_dbkey/encryption_cert_dbkey pref and nsIX509CertDB.findCertByDBKey() -- the same targeted lookup Thunderbird's own compose-security code uses when signing/encrypting, which the user found empirically recovers reading after it runs.
